factory.name: Diagram.create
factory.signature: Diagram.create(host: HTMLElement, options: DiagramOptions): Diagram; layoutDiagram(nodes: readonly DiagramLayoutNode[], edges: readonly DiagramLayoutEdge[], options?: DiagramLayoutOptions): DiagramLayoutResult; diagramToSvg(diagram: Diagram, options?: DiagramExportOptions): string; diagramToPng(diagram, options?): Promise<Blob>; downloadDiagram(diagram, options: DiagramDownloadOptions): Promise<void>

options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name of the diagram (canvas); the node list is named '{label}: nodes', the connection list '{label}: connections', and the toolbar '{label} controls'. Non-empty.

options.name: model
options.description: JSON model { nodes, edges, groups? }. Node: { id, label, shape? ('rectangle' | 'rounded' (default) | 'ellipse' | 'diamond' | 'parallelogram' | 'cylinder' | 'document' | 'custom'), x?, y?, width?, height? (16..2000), ports? ({ id, side, offset? }; default one per side: top, right, bottom, left), group?, pinned?, locked?, data? }. Edge: { id, from, to, fromPort?, toPort?, label?, routing?, arrowStart? (default 'none'), arrowEnd? (default 'arrow'; 'none' | 'arrow' | 'triangle' | 'diamond' | 'circle'), dashed?, data? }. Group: { id, label }. Validated (DIAGRAM_OPTIONS). Nodes without x/y are placed by auto-layout. Replacing it with update() clears the undo history.

options.name: editable
options.description: Edit mode: palette, ports, moving, connecting, reconnecting, inline labels, copy and paste, delete, marquee selection, undo and redo.

options.name: layout
options.description: Auto-layout settings { algorithm?: 'layered' | 'tree', direction?: 'TB' | 'BT' | 'LR' | 'RL', nodeGap?, rankGap?, sweeps?, keepPositions? }. Given on create, the layout runs once (keepPositions keeps nodes that have positions). Also the defaults of layout() and of placing nodes without positions.

options.name: palette
options.description: Shapes offered in edit mode: { shape, label, width?, height? }. Default: Step (rounded), Decision (diamond), Start or end (ellipse), Process, Input or output, Document, Database.

options.name: renderShape
options.description: Draws nodes with shape 'custom' ({ width, height, selected, doc } context): return SVG content in local coordinates. The label is drawn on top; return non-interactive content.

options.name: canConnect
options.description: Veto new and changed connections (pointer, keyboard, addEdge). Self connections and exact duplicates are always refused (announced).

options.name: historyLimit
options.description: Undo depth, integer 0..500 (0 disables history).

options.name: showGrid
options.description: Dotted grid on the canvas in edit mode.

options.name: nodeWidth
options.description: Default node width, integer 40..800 diagram px.

options.name: nodeHeight
options.description: Default node height, integer 24..600 diagram px.

options.name: gridSize
options.description: Grid spacing (snap, keyboard move step, grid dots), integer 4..200.

options.name: snapToGrid
options.description: Snap moved and added nodes to the grid (keyboard moves step by gridSize; off: 1 px).

options.name: routing
options.description: Default edge routing (an edge's own routing wins).

options.name: nodeGap
options.description: Auto-layout space between neighbors of one rank, integer 8..400.

options.name: rankGap
options.description: Auto-layout space between ranks, integer 16..600.

options.name: minZoom
options.description: Smallest zoom factor, 0.05..1.

options.name: maxZoom
options.description: Largest zoom factor, 1..8.

options.name: textAlternative
options.description: Nodes and connections table below the canvas: behind a Show text description button (toggle), always shown, visually hidden but available to screen readers, or none.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of messages, counts, and zoom percentages.

options.name: direction
options.description: rtl mirrors auto-layout and the reading order of nodes; arrow keys stay spatial.

properties.name: model
properties.description: The current model, in model order, with every node's position and size (copies, for saving).

properties.name: geometry
properties.description: Drawn geometry (node boxes, wrapped label lines, edge routes, group boxes, bounds) and sample elements for computed colors (used by the export functions).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options (validated first). model replaces the data (undo history cleared; nodes without positions are laid out). No event.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Replace the selection with these node and edge ids (no event).

methods.name: focusNode
methods.description: Focus a node and pan it into view.

methods.name: addNode
methods.description: Add a node; id, size, and position are filled in (position: a free spot at the view center). Undoable; emits aui-change ('add'); returns the id.

methods.name: addEdge
methods.signature: addEdge(edge: Partial<DiagramEdge> & { from: string; to: string }): string | null
methods.description: Connect two nodes; null when refused (self, duplicate, canConnect). Undoable; emits aui-change ('connect').

methods.name: updateNode | updateEdge
methods.signature: updateNode(id: string, patch: Partial<Omit<DiagramNode, 'id'>>): void; updateEdge(id: string, patch: Partial<Omit<DiagramEdge, 'id'>>): void
methods.description: Change one node or edge (validated). Undoable; emits aui-change ('update').

methods.name: moveNode
methods.signature: moveNode(id: string, x: number, y: number): void
methods.description: Move a node (snapped when snapToGrid). Undoable; emits aui-change ('move').

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Remove nodes (with their edges) and edges. Undoable; emits aui-change ('delete').

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Run auto-layout (defaults from the layout option), then fit. keepPositions keeps pinned and hand-moved nodes. Undoable; announces; emits aui-change ('layout').

methods.name: undo | redo
methods.description: Undo / redo the last edit (whole-model snapshots). Announce and emit aui-change ('undo' / 'redo'); false when there is nothing to undo/redo.

methods.name: copy | paste
methods.description: Copy the selected nodes and the edges between them into the instance clipboard; paste them offset by two grid steps (new ids), select them, emit aui-change ('paste').

methods.name: editLabel
methods.description: Open the inline label editor of a node or edge (edit mode). Enter or blur commits, Escape cancels.

methods.name: fit
methods.description: Scale (at most 100 %) and center the drawing; announces the zoom.

methods.name: zoomTo
methods.description: Zoom around the viewport center, clamped to minZoom..maxZoom; announces and emits aui-zoom.

methods.name: centerOn
methods.description: Center the view on a node.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Plain-text description: one line per node with its shape and connections.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove the toolbar, palette, viewport, text alternative, listeners, and host classes.

events.name: aui-change
events.detail: DiagramChangeDetail { reason: 'add' | 'move' | 'connect' | 'reconnect' | 'label' | 'delete' | 'paste' | 'layout' | 'update' | 'undo' | 'redo'; model: DiagramModel; ids: string[] }
events.description: The model changed through the UI or an API method. Save detail.model.

events.name: aui-select
events.description: The selection changed through the UI (click, Shift-click, marquee, Space, Ctrl/Cmd+A, Escape, paste, delete). select() does not emit.

events.name: aui-node-activate
events.description: A node was activated: Enter or double-click in view mode, or double-click on a locked node in edit mode.

events.name: aui-zoom
events.description: The zoom changed through the toolbar, keys, Ctrl/Cmd + wheel, or zoomTo (fit does not emit).

contentAreas.name: renderShape
contentAreas.description: SVG content of 'custom' nodes, re-rendered when the node's label, size, ports, or selection changes.

cssClasses.name: aui-diagram
cssClasses.description: Host; --editing in edit mode, --hand with the Pan tool, --placing while Move selection waits for a point, --connecting while a connection is being made.

cssClasses.name: aui-diagram__toolbar | __tool
cssClasses.description: Toolbar group and its buttons (aria-disabled when unavailable; Pan, Connect, and Move selection are toggles with aria-pressed).

cssClasses.name: aui-diagram__palette | __palette-item | __palette-shape
cssClasses.description: Edit-mode palette: buttons that add a shape (click) or are dragged onto the canvas.

cssClasses.name: aui-diagram__viewport | --panning
cssClasses.description: Focusable canvas (block-size 30rem by default); arrow keys pan.

cssClasses.name: aui-diagram__svg | __scene | __grid | __grid-dot
cssClasses.description: The SVG, the transformed scene, and the edit-mode grid.

cssClasses.name: aui-diagram__groups | __group | __group-box | __group-label
cssClasses.description: Group boxes around their member nodes.

cssClasses.name: aui-diagram__nodes | __node | --locked | --source | --moving | --target
cssClasses.description: Node listbox and options (transform attribute); states for locked nodes, the connect source, move mode, and the drop target.

cssClasses.name: aui-diagram__body | __shape | --custom | __shape-detail | __label | __focus
cssClasses.description: Node outline, cylinder rim, label text, and focus ring.

cssClasses.name: aui-diagram__links | __link | __link-hit | __link-ring | __link-core | __edge-label | __edge-label-bg | __edge-label-text | __handles | __handle
cssClasses.description: Connection listbox options: hit area, focus ring, label, and reconnect handles of a selected edge.

cssClasses.name: aui-diagram__overlay | __guide | __marquee | __preview | __ghost
cssClasses.description: Alignment guides, marquee, connection preview, palette drop ghost.

cssClasses.name: aui-diagram__editor
cssClasses.description: Inline label input (positioned through the CSSOM).

cssClasses.name: aui-diagram__text | --hidden | __text-toggle | __table-scroll | __table
cssClasses.description: Text alternative: toggle button and the nodes and connections table.

iconSlots.name: toolbar
iconSlots.default: zoom-out, zoom-in, maximize (fit), grip (Pan tool), link (Connect), locate (Move selection), undo, redo, trash (delete)
